text:
Predicates:
Winner(x, y) ::: x is the winner of the tournament y.
Participated(x, y) ::: x participated in the tournament y.
Leaderboard(x, y) ::: x is on the leaderboard of the tournament y.
From(x, y) ::: x is from the country y.
SixWayTie(y) ::: there was a six-way tie on the leaderboard of tournament y.
All(x, y) ::: all x are y.
Premises:
Winner(steinhauer, 1992DuMaurierClassic) ::: The winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic was Steinhauer.
Participated(steinhauer, 1992DuMaurierClassic) ::: Steinhauer participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∃x (SixWayTie(1992DuMaurierClassic) ∧ From(x, belgium)) ::: There was one six-way tie on the leaderboard and one person in the six-way tie was from Belgium.
From(descampe, belgium) ∧ Leaderboard(descampe, 1992DuMaurierClassic) ::: Descampe is from Belgium and is on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
∀x (Leaderboard(x, 1992DuMaurierClassic) → Participated(x, 1992DuMaurierClassic)) ::: All people on the leaderboard of the 1992 du Maurier Classic participated in the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
Conclusion:
¬Winner(steinhauer, 1992DuMaurierClassic) ::: Steinhauer was not the winner of the 1992 du Maurier Classic.
